info.description:
REST API for the Ride Pulse ride-hailing platform: riders, drivers and onboarding, fare estimates and surge pricing, trip booking and dispatch, payments and wallets, support and safety, and analytics. Live updates are pushed over WebSockets (`/ws/trips/<id>/`, `/ws/driver/`, `/ws/ops/`).

Authenticate with `POST /api/v1/auth/token/` and send `Authorization: Bearer <access>`.
